descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Painter is responsible for working with production to prepare finished pumps for the customer.
• Manage material movement through the department which aligns with the most immediate needs of internal customers to meet On-Time-Delivery (OTD) performance metrics.
• Operate overhead and manual floor lifting equipment to maneuver, load, and unload items onto and off of the paint line that exceed 50lbs.
• Utilize pre-coating agents, mix and match colors and textures according to specifications, and fill or level materials as required.
• Follow compound specifications for mixing of paints and painting techniques.
• Apply paint and any additional finishes according to sales order and work instructions.
• Read and interpret drawings, technical specifications and material data sheets.
• Maintain accurate and complete records as required.
• Perform quality inspections as described in quality plans and work instructions.
• Follow quality procedures according to ISO 9001.
• Commitment to following all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to, proper use of required PPE at all times. What we offer you
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
